text:
Silver Price in 1983
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1983, the LBMA silver price fell 35.5% between 1983-01-31 ($13.82) and 1983-12-30 ($8.91). The highest sampled price was $13.82 in January and the lowest was $8.74 in October. The mean of these observations was $11.33. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
